_comment: Single source of truth for all agents in the leafcutter ecosystem. When adding a new agent: (1) add an entry here, (2) create the template file, (3) run build.py --validate to confirm bidirectional consistency. business-analyst reads this file to build the agents: map for new tickets. trigger_conditions use the two-tier format per ADR-018: type=dsl for mechanically-evaluable rules, type=llm for natural-language judgment calls.

agent_categories._comment: Defines the five canonical agent categories and their default constraints. Each agent entry may carry a 'category' field referencing one of these keys. Per-agent explicit field values always override these category defaults. The 'category' field is additive to (not a replacement for) the existing 'tier' field: 'tier' describes supervisor-hierarchy role (phase/supervisor/utility); 'category' describes functional domain for capability inference. Category mapping for common agents: python-coder/sql-coder/frontend-coder/documentation-expert -> implementation; architect-review/pr-reviewer/business-analyst/it-po -> planning; test-writer/test-runner -> testing; research-agent -> research; ticket-supervisor/create-epic/create-ticket -> supervisor.

agents.name: Ticket Supervisor
agents.description: Drives a single ticket from needed agents to fully signed off. Dispatched directly at depth-0 by /build-feature (the user-facing entrypoint) or by the deprecated epic-supervisor during the deprecation window. Phase agents run at depth-1.

agents.name: Architect Review

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket changes interfaces, module boundaries, shared contracts, or introduces new cross-cutting patterns.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket adds a new public interface, class, or module
ticket modifies a shared contract (e.g. API schema, DB schema, skill protocol)
ticket crosses two or more component boundaries
ticket introduces a new design pattern or architectural abstraction
files_touched contains models/*.py OR files_touched contains alembic/versions/ OR files_touched contains api/api.py OR files_touched contains docs/architecture/

agents.priority_rationale: Runs after ADR and diagram authors; shapes design before any implementation begins

agents.name: Python Coder

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket involves creating, modifying, or refactoring Python code.

trigger_conditions.expression: files_touched contains *.py
ticket involves creating, modifying, or refactoring Python code
ticket requires new unit tests
ticket involves Python configuration or build scripts

knowledge_channels.description: Project instructions, error handling policy, shell conventions
Module-level context when cwd overlaps edited module folder

knowledge_channels.source: signoff SKILL.md; doc-enforcer SKILL.md; complexity-reduction; collector-enforcer
knowledge_channels.description: Sign-off protocol, docstring enforcement, complexity scoring, collector pattern enforcement
Model: sonnet, tools: Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Agent, signoff: true, config_keys, portable: true
Agents map, files_touched, depends_on, ACs, Agent Contracts section
Available tool surface and usage guidance
Project jargon definitions via CLAUDE.md ref

agents.priority_rationale: Primary implementation agent; runs after architectural review is complete

agents.name: Test Writer

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket includes test_requirements with a non-empty tests array.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket body contains a non-empty test_requirements.tests array
ticket adds or modifies testable Python or SQL logic
files_touched contains unit_tests/

agents.priority_rationale: Writes failing tests before coders implement; ensures tests exist and are red before any production code is written

agents.name: Test Runner

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket adds or modifies Python code that has testable logic.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket adds or modifies Python functions or classes with non-trivial logic
ticket introduces new behavior that should be regression-tested
files_touched contains unit_tests/ OR files_touched contains test_*.py

agents.priority_rationale: Validates test suite after test-writer completes; must run after tests are written

agents.name: Documentation Expert

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires documentation changes in docs/ or adds/modifies agents/skills that need README entries.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket adds a new agent, skill, or workflow
ticket changes a public interface that is documented in docs/
files_touched contains docs/*.md
ticket is a docs-only change

agents.priority_rationale: Documents changes after code and tests are complete; runs before final PR review

behavioral_patterns.trigger: Request requires a full diataxis-typed document (how-to guide, ADR, C4 diagram, explanation, or reference page), OR the guide or doc exceeds 5 implementation steps, OR the user explicitly requests a named doc type
behavioral_patterns.action: Classify intent → dispatch matching specialist (how-to-author, adr-author, architecture-diagram-author, explanation-author, reference-author) via Agent tool
behavioral_patterns.decision_boundary: Delegates when: (1) output is a standalone doc file requiring its own diataxis genre structure, (2) guide exceeds ~5 steps, (3) ADR-level decision record is needed, (4) C4 diagram at any flight level is requested

behavioral_patterns.trigger: Request is a simple inline doc update — e.g. adding a paragraph to an existing doc, updating a table row, fixing a factual error, or appending a short note — AND the change does not require a new diataxis-structured document
behavioral_patterns.action: Write or edit the documentation file directly using Bash/Read/Edit/Write tools without spawning a specialist sub-agent
behavioral_patterns.decision_boundary: Handles directly when: (1) change targets an existing doc file (not a new standalone doc), (2) no diataxis genre routing is required, (3) change is a single-file patch of low structural complexity

behavioral_patterns.trigger: After any doc write, agent detects novel project terms in the output
behavioral_patterns.action: Spawn glossary-triage to classify candidate terms
behavioral_patterns.decision_boundary: Always runs post-write; glossary-triage is always a conditional delegation

agents.name: Change Scope Reviewer

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket has a non-empty out_of_scope list or touches multiple components where scope drift is a concern.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket frontmatter contains out_of_scope field with at least one entry
ticket touches multiple top-level components and scope drift is a meaningful risk

agents.priority_rationale: Runs after coder phase and before pr-reviewer; verifies the actual change set matches the planned scope

agents.name: PR Reviewer

selection_criteria.description: Assign to every ticket that produces a code or documentation change — this is the final quality gate before commit.

trigger_conditions.expression: any code, SQL, configuration, or documentation file is modified
ticket produces any artifact that will be committed

agents.priority_rationale: Final quality gate; runs after all implementation and documentation is complete

agents.name: Commit

selection_criteria.description: Assign to every ticket that produces a committed artifact.

trigger_conditions.expression: any file will be committed to the git repository

agents.priority_rationale: Atomic commit phase; runs after PR review approves the change

agents.name: Pull Request

selection_criteria.description: Assign to every ticket that produces a committed artifact requiring a pull request.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket produces commits that should be reviewed via PR before merging

agents.priority_rationale: Pushes branch and opens PR; final step in the ticket lifecycle

agents.name: Status Checker

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires verifying existing system state before changes can be planned.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket involves debugging or diagnosing an existing system issue
ticket requires checking current state before deciding implementation approach

agents.priority_rationale: Runs before any author or coder; verifies current system state is as expected

agents.name: SQL Coder

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket involves SQL objects: tables, procedures, functions, views, or indexes.

trigger_conditions.expression: files_touched contains sql_functions/ OR files_touched contains alembic/versions/
ticket creates or modifies SQL stored procedures, functions, or views
ticket involves database schema changes
ticket adds or modifies database hypertables or continuous aggregates

agents.priority_rationale: Database implementation; co-equal with python-coder but sequential by default (priority 7 vs 6)

agents.name: Frontend Coder

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket involves creating or modifying frontend/UI components, markup, or styles; or when files_touched contains frontend file extensions.

trigger_conditions.expression: files_touched contains *.tsx OR files_touched contains *.jsx OR files_touched contains *.vue OR files_touched contains *.svelte OR files_touched contains *.html OR files_touched contains *.css OR files_touched contains *.scss
ticket involves creating or modifying frontend/UI components, markup, or styles
ticket requires visual changes to a web interface

agents.priority_rationale: Frontend implementation; runs after sql-coder (7) so database schema changes are complete before UI is built, and before test-runner (9) so tests can verify the rendered output

agents.name: SQL Query

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires authoring or refining ad-hoc SQL queries for analysis, reporting, or debugging.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket asks to write or refine a SQL SELECT query for analysis or reporting
ticket involves debugging a query or understanding query performance

agents.priority_rationale: Ad-hoc query authoring; co-equal with sql-coder (both priority 7) but for read-only queries

agents.name: ADR Author

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires authoring or updating an Architecture Decision Record.

trigger_conditions.expression: requires_adr: true in ticket frontmatter
ticket introduces a new cross-cutting policy, constraint, or architectural decision

agents.priority_rationale: ADR must exist before coders or diagram authors reference architectural decisions

agents.name: Architecture Diagram Author

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires authoring a C4 mermaid architecture diagram.

trigger_conditions.expression: requires_diagram: true in ticket frontmatter
ticket introduces a new data flow, container, context, or component-level architectural view

agents.priority_rationale: Diagram must exist before coders reference the architecture; runs after ADR author

agents.name: Explanation Author

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires a new explanation document in docs/explanation/.

trigger_conditions.expression: requires_documentation contains explanation in ticket frontmatter
ticket introduces a new concept, design rationale, or architectural tradeoff that needs an understanding-oriented explanation

agents.priority_rationale: Documentation specialist; runs in the documentation phase alongside documentation-expert

agents.name: How-To Author

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires a new how-to guide in docs/how-to/.

trigger_conditions.expression: requires_documentation contains how_to in ticket frontmatter
ticket introduces a new workflow, procedure, or tool that needs a step-by-step guide

agents.priority_rationale: Documentation specialist; runs in the documentation phase alongside documentation-expert

agents.name: Reference Author

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires a new reference document in docs/reference/.

trigger_conditions.expression: requires_documentation contains reference in ticket frontmatter
ticket introduces a new configuration, schema, or API surface that needs a reference table

agents.priority_rationale: Documentation specialist; runs in the documentation phase alongside documentation-expert

agents.name: User Surface Smoker

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket introduces or modifies a user-facing surface (slash command, pre-commit hook, agent-orchestrated entrypoint, or cron script). Conditional: only emitted in the agents: map when user_facing_surface != null in the ticket frontmatter.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket frontmatter user_facing_surface != null
ticket introduces a new slash command, pre-commit hook, or agent-orchestrated entrypoint
ticket modifies the production dispatch path of an existing user-facing surface

agents.priority_rationale: Runs after pr-reviewer (11) confirms tests green, before commit (12) locks the worktree. Invokes the surface end-to-end with production wiring and asserts observable side-effects. See ADR-036.

agents.name: AC Validator

selection_criteria.description: Assign to any ticket that has an ## Agent Contracts or ## Acceptance Criteria section with AC-N lines, to gate commit on verified AC coverage.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket body contains an ## Agent Contracts or ## Acceptance Criteria section with at least one - [ ] AC-N: line
ticket requires proof that every acceptance criterion has implementation and test evidence before commit

agents.priority_rationale: Final AC coverage gate; runs after pr-reviewer (11) and before commit (12) to verify all ACs are evidenced before the worktree is locked
agents.description: Reads ticket ACs, the working diff, and test output; produces a coverage verdict (ok / blocker / question). Never implements — read-only on code files, edits only the ticket file.

agents.name: AC Fulfillment Gate

selection_criteria.description: Assign to any ticket that has an ac_traceability frontmatter key referencing L2/L3 AC YAML files, to gate commit on verified AC store field accuracy.

trigger_conditions.expression: ticket frontmatter contains ac_traceability with l2 or l3 AC IDs referencing AC YAML files
ticket requires verification that AC YAML store fields (work_status, implemented_by, covered_by) are accurate before commit

agents.priority_rationale: AC store fulfillment gate; runs after ac-validator (11.5) and before commit (12) to verify AC YAML store fields are accurate and up-to-date
agents.description: Verifies AC YAML store fields (work_status, implemented_by, covered_by) are accurate before commit. Auto-fixes when diff evidence exists (append-only, idempotent). Returns ok if all ACs pass or ac_traceability absent; blocker with per-AC details if any AC fails after auto-fix.

agents.name: LLM Expert

selection_criteria.description: Assign when the ticket requires authoring, editing, or auditing agent templates, skill bodies, or slash-command markdown files.

trigger_conditions.expression: files_touched contains templates/agents/*.md OR files_touched contains templates/skills/*/SKILL.md OR files_touched contains templates/workflows/*.md
ticket adds or modifies an agent template, skill body, or slash-command workflow file
ticket requires applying the Prompt-Quality Checklist to an agent or skill

agents.priority_rationale: Authoring phase agent; runs after architectural review and before test-runner/pr-reviewer
agents.description: Authors, edits, and audits agent templates, skill bodies, and slash-command markdown files. Applies the Prompt-Quality Checklist.

agents.name: Product Owner
agents.description: Product Owner for v3 ticket-creation pipeline. Operates at L0/L1 flight level: translates user requests into customer value propositions and feature benefit statements. Speaks customer language, never engineering jargon.

agents.name: Business Analyst
agents.description: Business Analyst for v3 ticket-creation pipeline. Operates at L2/L3 flight level: decomposes L1 feature ACs into testable Gherkin behaviors and edge-case specifications. Produces AC YAML files.

agents.name: IT Product Owner
agents.description: IT Product Owner for v3 ticket-creation pipeline. Enriches L2/L3 AC YAML files with technical fields: assigned_agent, it_requirements, estimated_complexity, delivers_to/expects_from contracts, and doc_links.

agents.name: Build AC
agents.description: AC-to-ticket-to-build entry-point coordinator. Calls ac_prioritizer.py to find the top-ranked ready AC, generates a ticket via generate_ticket_from_ac.py, surfaces the ticket to the user for confirmation (yes / review / skip), and documents how to mark the AC done after a successful build. Does NOT call /build-feature inline — depth-cap constraint (ADR-006). Invoked by /build-ac slash command.

knowledge_channels.source: bash command output (ac_prioritizer.py, generate_ticket_from_ac.py, build_ac_mode_detection.py, goal_to_epic.py)

agents.name: AC Triage
agents.description: Haiku-pinned AC store triage agent. Stage 0 of the /plan-feature workflow. Reads active ACs for the relevant component, classifies the user's request as strategic / behavioral / technical / covered, and returns a structured JSON routing decision. Read-only — never writes files. Must complete in < 3s for ≤200 ACs.

knowledge_channels.source: AC YAML files read from docs/acceptance-criteria/

agents.name: Product-Truth Classifier
agents.description: Product-truth request classifier. Given a plain-language feature request, decides needs_flow / needs_mock_data / needs_mockup (a boolean each), derives the routing outcome (full-set / mockup+data / mockup-only / mock-data-only / none), and names the target component, entities, and add-vs-create decision. Read-only — returns a structured JSON decision the authoring pipeline routes on so only the needed authoring agents run. Scored against docs/product-truth/classifier/eval.jsonl.

knowledge_channels.source: product-truth store files read during execution (README, eval.jsonl, schemas, index.json)

agents.name: Mock Data Author
agents.description: Mock-data authoring agent for the product-truth store. Given a classified request naming a component and entities, drafts or EXTENDS the one canonical dataset for those entities (realistic *.mock.json records conforming to mock-data.schema.json), enforcing the add-vs-create rule: one canonical dataset per entity per component, extended in place, never duplicated. Registers the artifact in index.json artifacts[] and runs generate_product_truth.py; never hand-edits derived index maps.

knowledge_channels.source: product-truth store files read during execution (README, schema, gold seed, index.json)

agents.name: Mockup Author
agents.description: Mockup authoring agent for the product-truth store. Given drafted mock data and a request that involves screens, drafts or extends in place a mockup per screen (*.mockup.json conforming to mockup.schema.json plus a self-contained HTML rendering), populated from the mock records rather than placeholder text, registering a screen id the flow's steps resolve. Registers the artifact in index.json artifacts[] and runs generate_product_truth.py; never hand-edits derived index maps.

knowledge_channels.source: product-truth store files read during execution (README, schema, gold seed, mock data, index.json)

agents.name: Flow Author
agents.description: Flow authoring agent for the product-truth store. Given drafted mock data and mockups for a multi-step request, assembles a draft flow (*.flow.json conforming to flow.schema.json): ordered steps wired to their screens and read/write entities, with one acceptance_scenario per step for the business-analyst to turn into ACs. Follows the add-vs-create rule (extends an existing journey rather than creating a new flow). Leaves step.implements and impl_status to the business-analyst / generator. Registers the artifact in index.json artifacts[] and runs generate_product_truth.py.

knowledge_channels.source: product-truth store files read during execution (README, schema, gold seed, mockups, mock data, index.json)
